title.zh: It’s not AI anymore, it’s ‘super intelligence’ (according to the White House)
title.en: It’s not AI anymore, it’s ‘super intelligence’ (according to the White House)

current_state.zh: The White House gathered major tech CEOs including Zuckerberg, Bezos, Musk and Anthropic's Dario Amodei to sign an AI safety pledge President Trump described as 'morally binding,' while also signing an executive order rebranding AI as 'super intelligence.'
current_state.en: The White House gathered major tech CEOs including Zuckerberg, Bezos, Musk and Anthropic's Dario Amodei to sign an AI safety pledge President Trump described as 'morally binding,' while also signing an executive order rebranding AI as 'super intelligence.'
